system.description:
Play the Mastermind if you want to analyze your foes and strike where they are weak.

Features

Exploit. When you succeed on an attack against a target, spend a Hope to make the target temporarily Vulnerable.

Press the Advantage. Once per Rest, when an adversary within Close range takes damage and marks HP from an ally’s attack, you can move to them and strike. On a success, the adversary marks the same number of HP again.
